title_norm: 近700亿美元ipo定价突然撤回anthropic最快今天路演下周冲刺上市
title_en: Nearly $70B IPO Pricing Suddenly Withdrawn! Anthropic Roadshow Could Start Today, Listing Targeted for Next Week
title_zh: 近700亿美元IPO定价突然撤回！Anthropic最快今天路演，下周冲刺上市
summary_en: A nearly $70 billion IPO pricing was abruptly withdrawn, while Anthropic may begin its roadshow as soon as today and aims to list next week, marking a major moment for AI startup financing.
summary_zh: 近700亿美元IPO定价突然撤回，Anthropic最快今日启动路演，计划下周上市，成为AI初创公司融资的重要节点。

title: Claude chatbot maker set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning
summary: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78, which is lower than what was expected.
title_en: Claude Maker Anthropic Set for $1.3tn Stock Market Debut Despite 'Catastrophic' AI Warning
title_zh: Claude开发商Anthropic拟以1.3万亿美元估值上市，无视AI“灾难性”警告
summary_en: The AI company behind Claude will offer shares at $70–$78, below expectations, in a debut valuing it at $1.3tn despite warnings about catastrophic AI risks.
summary_zh: Claude开发商Anthropic将以每股70至78美元的价格上市，低于预期，估值达1.3万亿美元，尽管存在AI灾难性风险警告。

title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic Face New Oversight as New York's AI Safety Law Takes Effect
title_zh: 纽约AI安全法生效，OpenAI与Anthropic面临新监管
summary_en: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
summary_zh: 纽约州即将执行全面的AI安全法，要求OpenAI、Anthropic等主要开发商注册、披露安全实践并报告重大事故，否则将面临罚款。

title: CoreWeave beats on revenue and lifts guidance, easing AI slowdown concerns
summary: CoreWeave's stock has been hammered heading into the neocloud's Q3 earnings report.
title_en: CoreWeave Beats Revenue Estimates, Lifts Guidance to Ease AI Slowdown Fears
title_zh: CoreWeave营收超预期并上调指引，缓解AI放缓担忧
summary_en: CoreWeave topped Q3 revenue estimates and raised its guidance, reassuring investors worried about an AI spending slowdown after the neocloud's stock had fallen sharply ahead of the report.
summary_zh: CoreWeave第三季度营收超出预期并上调业绩指引，缓解了投资者对AI支出放缓的担忧；此前该新云厂商股价在财报发布前大幅下跌。

title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
summary: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
title_en: Grok Build coding agent leaks confidential data, including SpaceX info
title_zh: Grok Build编程代理泄露机密数据，含SpaceX信息
summary_en: A researcher found 35,000 Grok Build apps publicly exposed, leaking confidential information, some belonging to SpaceX. The coding agent's misconfiguration left sensitive data open to anyone who looked.
summary_zh: 研究人员发现3.5万个Grok Build应用公开暴露，泄露机密信息，部分属于SpaceX。该编程代理的配置失误使敏感数据对任何查找者开放。

title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
summary: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
title_en: All 7 Anthropic Founders to Cash Out About $250M Each in IPO
title_zh: Anthropic七位联合创始人IPO各套现约2.5亿美元
summary_en: Each of Anthropic's seven co-founders plans to sell an identical number of shares in the IPO, netting roughly $250 million each at the midpoint price while keeping the group in control of the company.
summary_zh: Anthropic七位联合创始人计划在IPO中出售相同数量的股份，按发行价区间中值计算每人约套现2.5亿美元，同时该团队仍保持对公司的控制权。

title: Op-ed: In Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's alleged China spy scandal, there's plenty of blame to go around
summary: In the AI era, our economic competitiveness, military capabilities, and intelligence edge can be taken down by one man. We aren't prepared. Congress must act.
title_en: Op-ed: In Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Alleged China Spy Scandal, There's Plenty of Blame to Go Around
title_zh: 评论：英伟达CEO黄仁勋涉嫌中国间谍丑闻，多方难辞其咎
summary_en: An op-ed argues that one man could undermine US economic competitiveness, military capabilities, and intelligence edge in the AI era, and that Congress must act to prepare.
summary_zh: 一篇评论文章指出，在AI时代，一个人的行为就可能削弱美国的经济竞争力、军事能力和情报优势，国会必须采取行动。

title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”
title_en: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
title_zh: Oura以6.25亿美元收购AI原生初级保健初创公司Counsel Health
summary_en: Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M, weeks after indefinitely postponing its up to $2.2B IPO due to IPO market uncertainty.
summary_zh: Oura宣布以6.25亿美元收购AI原生初级保健初创公司Counsel Health，此前数周其因IPO市场不确定性无限期推迟了最高22亿美元的上市计划。

title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
summary: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.
title_en: PSI Turns AI-Driven Scientific Discovery Into a Business
title_zh: PSI将AI驱动的科学发现商业化
summary_en: PSI is commercializing AI-driven scientific discovery after using an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a quantum computing question scientists pursued for nearly two decades.
summary_zh: PSI利用未发布的Anthropic模型解答了科学家近二十年未解的量子计算难题，并正将AI驱动的科学发现推向商业化。

title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
summary: ChatGPT is going to let you chat with verified "Business Agents" that represent a brand to help you with things like comparison shopping. The feature, available first to "eligible" e-commerce and online service businesses in the US, is launching as part of a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT being announced today in beta. You […]
title_en: ChatGPT Adds Verified AI 'Business Agents' for Brands
title_zh: ChatGPT推出经认证的AI“商业代理”
summary_en: ChatGPT is launching verified 'Business Agents' that represent brands and help users with tasks like comparison shopping, starting with eligible US e-commerce and online service businesses as part of a new business-focused beta suite.
summary_zh: ChatGPT推出经认证的“商业代理”，代表品牌协助用户进行比价购物等任务，首批面向美国符合条件的电商和在线服务企业，属于新商业功能测试套件的一部分。

title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
summary: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.
title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings，将职场讨论转化为计划与任务
summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Meetings, which drafts plans, maps timelines on a whiteboard, answers chat questions, and pulls data from connected work apps during discussions.
summary_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings，可在会议中起草计划、在白板绘制时间线、回答聊天提问，并调取关联工作应用中的数据。

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
summary: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Alleged Affair with Chinese Spy: A Timeline
title_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍的绯闻：时间线梳理
summary_en: Reports allege an affair between Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a woman described as a Chinese spy, raising national security concerns amid US-China AI competition.
summary_zh: 有报道称英伟达CEO黄仁勋与一名被指为中国间谍的女性存在婚外情，在中美AI竞争背景下引发国家安全担忧。

title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
summary: For years, Anthropic has been known for its focus on enterprise and coding tools that attract high-flying corporate clients, inspiring competing frontier labs - like OpenAI, SpaceXSI, and Meta - to copy its strategies. Earlier this year, Claude Code went through its own particular hype cycle. And now, Anthropic is trying to expand its footprint […]
title_en: Anthropic Launches Its Own AI-Powered Office Suite
title_zh: Anthropic推出自有AI办公套件
summary_en: Anthropic, long focused on enterprise and coding tools like Claude Code, is expanding its footprint with a new AI-powered office suite, intensifying competition with OpenAI, Meta, and other frontier labs.
summary_zh: Anthropic长期专注企业与编程工具，如今推出AI办公套件扩展业务版图，加剧与OpenAI、Meta等前沿实验室的竞争。

title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.
title_en: OpenAI Acquires Odessia, Travel Startup Founded by Sonder's Founder
title_zh: OpenAI收购由Sonder创始人创办的旅游初创公司Odessia
summary_en: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup created by Sonder founder Francis Davidson. The company has not disclosed its plans for the travel sector, though Davidson is a prominent figure in the industry.
summary_zh: OpenAI已收购由Sonder创始人弗朗西斯·戴维森创办的旅游初创公司Odessia，但尚未透露其在旅游领域的计划。戴维森是旅游业的知名人物。

title: Amazon's Ring unveils flying drone and robot to patrol homes and businesses
summary: Amazon's $250 Ring Drone Cam flies from room to room to investigate suspicious activity, and can capture footage at night.
title_en: Amazon's Ring unveils flying drone and robot to patrol homes and businesses
title_zh: 亚马逊Ring推出飞行无人机和机器人，巡逻家庭与企业
summary_en: Amazon's Ring launched a $250 Ring Drone Cam that flies room to room to investigate suspicious activity and capture night footage, plus a patrol robot for homes and businesses.
summary_zh: 亚马逊Ring发布售价250美元的Ring Drone Cam，可逐屋飞行调查可疑活动并夜间拍摄，同时推出用于家庭和企业的巡逻机器人。

title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
summary: A man speaks into a phone. Text on the screen reads 'Gemini Intelligence'
title_en: Gemini Intelligence Expands to More Devices with New Features
title_zh: Gemini Intelligence 新增功能并扩展至更多设备
summary_en: Google announces new Gemini Intelligence features rolling out across more devices, deepening its AI assistant integration into everyday hardware and user experiences.
summary_zh: 谷歌宣布 Gemini Intelligence 推出新功能并扩展至更多设备，进一步将 AI 助手融入日常硬件与用户体验。

title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
summary: As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world's most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs, and all manner of important people. He also wears a cool leather jacket. Which makes […]
title_en: The US Is Winning the AI Race. Jensen Huang Could Have Blown It
title_zh: 美国正赢得AI竞赛，黄仁勋险些搞砸
summary_en: The Verge examines how Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, a prime espionage target given his control of AI-critical technology, became central to US AI dominance—and how close he came to jeopardizing it.
summary_zh: The Verge分析英伟达CEO黄仁勋作为掌控AI关键技术的头号间谍目标，如何成为美国AI主导地位的核心，以及他险些令这一优势付诸东流。

title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
summary: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.
title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out Business Profiles, Making ChatGPT More Like Google
title_zh: OpenAI推出企业资料功能，ChatGPT更像谷歌
summary_en: OpenAI is adding business profiles and related features to ChatGPT, aiming to turn the chatbot into a stronger consumer discovery engine where companies can showcase themselves and reach users directly.
summary_zh: OpenAI为ChatGPT新增企业资料等功能，旨在将其打造为更强大的消费者发现引擎，让企业能够展示自身并直接触达用户。

title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
summary: Some Independent Games Festival (IGF) jurors published a statement yesterday saying they would not vote for games that use generative AI in "any capacity." Soon after, the developer of indie hit Big Walk has published a statement saying it "sparingly" used AI in the "final stretch" of the game's development to "help work through difficult […]
title_en: Indie Game Community Divided Over AI as Big Walk Admits Using It
title_zh: 独立游戏界因AI分裂，《Big Walk》承认使用AI
summary_en: IGF jurors vow not to vote for games using generative AI in any capacity, while indie hit Big Walk's developer admits using AI sparingly during the final stretch of development, sparking community debate.
summary_zh: IGF评委声明不会投票给任何使用生成式AI的游戏，而独立游戏热门作品《Big Walk》的开发者承认在开发最后阶段少量使用了AI，引发社区争议。
